title: ASGI Request Context and Access Log
instructions: Implement `RequestContextMiddleware` and `AccessLogMiddleware` in `asgi_mw.py` as pure ASGI classes (no Starlette or FastAPI). The first accepts a safe inbound request ID or generates one, stores it in `request_id_var` for the request and echoes it in the response headers. The second emits exactly one compact JSON line per HTTP request from a `finally` block, with status 500 if the inner app crashed. Non-HTTP scopes pass straight through.

evidence.label: Accepts a valid inbound request ID, echoes it and resets the context variable
Generates a uuid4 hex ID for missing, unsafe, empty or over-long IDs
Appends the ID header to http.response.start and leaves other messages alone
Resets the context variable and propagates the error when the inner app raises
Passes non-http scopes straight to the inner app without logging
Logs one compact JSON line with request_id, method, path, status and duration_ms
Rounds duration_ms to one decimal and captures the response status
Logs status 500 and re-raises when the inner app crashes before responding
Emits one line per request and keeps the real status if the crash comes after response start
